question: Can declared named queries distinguish known false from missing authority and govern a real finite service without a query creating an action, receipt or fitting?
method: Inspect exact identical DEV/DIST dialogue runtime and variants; compare a fully known bounded source-shaped query subset through separate Python and C# evaluators; execute an original single-offer policy through the existing actual MemoryStudy owner and browser.
brain_contributions: SCI-077 no simulated people or duplicated studies
source_boundaries: The source declares HasTag, HasFlag and HasRecentEvent; only the first two occur in the supplied dialogue variant rows. Recent-event cases must be labeled helper-branch probes, not table rows.
Python is an independently authored bounded known-input oracle over inspected source branches, not Ruby/RGSS/RMXP execution.

Missing source tag/flag providers become false; HasRecentEvent strips @digits/:digits before lookup. Strict private authority must not silently equate unknown with known false or inherit suffix normalization.
The existing scalar grammar, source permissive parser and whole dialogue/scoring/catalog remain separate. No source fiction or table permissions are imported.

declared_original_consumer.setup: Existing four parts, two coins, two named benches and action-turn costs.
declared_original_consumer.rule: An accepted explicit decline permanently records the exact named relation offer-closed. A later paid demonstration restores current support/recent evidence but cannot reopen that offer under this policy. Independent policy retains its existing renewable behavior.
declared_original_consumer.authority: Existing Room privately owns actual flags/events/costs/receipts; a condition only observes a frozen known named context.
declared_original_consumer.limits: An original disclosed experimental contract, not historical world canon, moral judgment, new source permission, full quest system or human social finding.

acceptance: Compile only declared exact HasTag/HasFlag/HasRecentEvent references; reject unknown names, IDs, malformed calls, undeclared aliases, unsupported suffixes and trailing syntax.
Prevalidate every referenced query and scalar before short-circuit evaluation; missing/wrong context remains incomplete and false, including query=false and an otherwise true OR branch.
Snapshots are immutable/exact and do not expose a delegate capable of mutating an owner during evaluation; reads never write flags, spend resources or produce receipts.
The same fully known source cases receive the same expected results in independent Python and actual C#; strict-negative differences are separately labeled rather than called source equivalence.

Single-offer actual help→decline→paid demonstration pays the existing two parts/two turns, restores recent/support, retains closure and refuses service without coin/turn/output. Independent contrast permits the same later eligible paid service.

Closing one exact named bench never closes or supplies the other; acquired fitting remains acquired after decline/expiry; repeated declined/stale/malformed input cannot manufacture closure, refund or a receipt.
Actual browser form/buttons, condition text, closed-offer disclosure, disabled service and computed SVG fitting visibility agree with independent HTTP owner observation.
Detect at least one actual isolated false-open/false-fitting renderer and one false query/source result. Retain exact producers, failures and corrected runs.

Reexecute affected unchanged scalar/Memory/Field consumers because shared library/host/input closure changes; report overlapping controls separately from independent studies. Preserve old independent and ordered outcomes.
Bind source/protocol/current implementation identities before and after actual execution and retain all negatives, artifacts and bounded host cleanup.
primary_rival_explanations: A result may come from an old duplicate eligibility guard while the new query is ignored; query conditions must demonstrably affect actual single-offer service.
False may mean absence/unknown instead of a known closed offer; incomplete-negative and wrong-subject controls distinguish them.
UI may infer output from condition truth or paid demonstration; independent actual snapshot and renderer mutants must reject this.
Single-offer refusal may be caused by exhausted parts, expiry or no coin instead of closure; retain paid fresh demonstration with current support/recent and sufficient coin at refusal.

reporting.units: Individual software controls and actual accepted/refused owner transitions; groups overlap and are not people, independent studies or measured effort.
no_claims: No Unity Editor/license/module or Windows/Steam execution
No Build/Operations completion or measured productivity

execution_bounds: Existing host lifetime and request/test timeouts remain; outputs external/new; local hosts stopped and no policy bypass.
